description: Public registry data for a Brazilian company (Receita Federal, via BrasilAPI): legal name, registration status, main activity, address, size, tax regime and partners (QSA). Accepts a CNPJ with or without punctuation, including the alphanumeric format. Partner CPFs come masked by the registry. Use it to check that a company exists and is active.

include_partners.description: Include the partners list (default true); false keeps the answer short

name: lookup_cnpj
title: Look up a company by CNPJ
